hypotheses.hypothesis: Aggregate-value helpers and return values may preserve the retail address and color-copy temporaries through MWCC inlining.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: aggregate vector values expanded the body to 776 bytes; aggregate color helpers did not improve the baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A local vector pointer biased by one array element, with all indices adjusted, makes MWCC retain the symbol-base address separately from pointer arithmetic.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed improvement: direct addi r30 in the prologue and addi r4,r30,0 at the first effect call match retail; all ten effective vector addresses are unchanged.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Place the volatile second-color staging variable after the other color locals to reproduce the retail stack layout.
hypotheses.result: Confirmed improvement: stage at 0x8(r1), second argument at 0x20(r1), later arguments at 0x1c/0x18/0x14/0x10/0xc. One extra lwz from the staging slot remains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Packed-color alias/union access may remove the remaining color reload while preserving its two stores.
hypotheses.result: The stores match, but MWCC swaps the long-lived vector/object/palette registers, reducing the measured score. Rejected.
